title: Invisible Sulfur Cubes
description: A Resource Pack that just makes Sulfur Cubes invisible.
body:
🧱🚫When **Sulfur Cubes** eats a **block**, they get **invisible** until you use **shears** on it.✂️✅

🍦Works on **Vanilla**.

🐥Made for **Tiny Takeover** snapshots (26.1-snapshot1-26.1-snapshot8) and soon for **Chaos Cubed** final version.

![Sulfur cube that ate planks with the resource pack activated.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7654250421a43998a6f0641297a79748df91d808.png)
